images.title: Three triangles named by their sides
images.purpose: Show the concept's three triangles A (6 cm, 6 cm, 6 cm), B (7 cm, 5 cm, 4 cm) and C (8 cm, 8 cm, 3 cm) with their equal sides ticked and equal angles marked, named equilateral, scalene and isosceles.
images.composition: Three triangles on one base line, each with its sides labelled, the equal sides ticked and the equal angles marked with small arcs; under each triangle its name and how many sides and angles are equal.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816, three triangles side by side on one level base line at y 540, drawn to scale (38 px for every 1 cm). The letters A, B and C in bold dark #1F2937 sans-serif, 56 px, centred at (250,150), (728,150) and (1206,150). TRIANGLE A, exactly 1 triangle with corners (136,540), (364,540) and (250,343) (3 sides of 228 px), filled teal #0072B2 with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px). Exactly 3 equal-sides ticks, one across the middle of each side, short straight lines in reddish purple #CC79A7, 5 px thick, 28 px long: (207,450) to (179,433), (293,450) to (321,433) and (250,526) to (250,554). Exactly 3 small white arcs (5 px thick, radius 34 px) inside the triangle, one at each corner. Side labels in bold dark text, 32 px: 6 cm centred at (158,421) outside the left side, 6 cm centred at (342,421) outside the right side, and 6 cm centred at (250,578) under the base. TRIANGLE B, exactly 1 triangle with corners (595,540), (861,540) and (752,434) (base 266 px, left side 190 px, right side 152 px), filled amber #E69F00 with the same outline. No ticks and no arcs. Side labels, 32 px bold: 5 cm centred at (651,454) outside the left side, 4 cm centred at (834,458) outside the right side, and 7 cm centred at (728,578) under the base. TRIANGLE C, exactly 1 triangle with corners (1149,540), (1263,540) and (1206,241) (base 114 px, each long side 304 px), filled green #009E73 with the same outline. Exactly 2 equal-sides ticks, one across the middle of each long side: (1193,393) to (1162,388) and (1219,393) to (1250,388). Exactly 2 small white arcs (5 px thick, radius 34 px) inside the triangle, one at each base corner. Side labels, 32 px bold: 8 cm centred at (1138,383) outside the left long side, 8 cm centred at (1274,383) outside the right long side, and 3 cm centred at (1206,578) under the base. UNDER EACH TRIANGLE three lines of text centred under it: for A the lines equilateral (bold dark, 44 px, at y 650), 3 equal sides (32 px, y 698) and 3 equal angles (32 px, y 740); for B the lines scalene, no equal sides and no equal angles; for C the lines isosceles, 2 equal sides and 2 equal angles, all at the same heights. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any number written on an angle, and any angle-measuring tool, anywhere in the frame
any shape drawn out of proportion to the stated side lengths
any tick or arc on triangle B
more or fewer than 3 ticks and 3 arcs on triangle A
triangles drawn with equal sides that the labels give as different
images.takeaway: Count the equal sides: 3 equal sides is equilateral, 2 is isosceles and none is scalene, and the equal angles match the equal sides.
images.description: Triangle A with 3 equal sides of 6 cm, triangle B with sides 7 cm, 5 cm and 4 cm, and triangle C with sides 8 cm, 8 cm and 3 cm, each named by its sides.
images.context: Concept image for Equilateral and Scalene Triangles. It follows the idea of the figures in your maths book (triangles with 3 equal sides, 2 equal sides and no equal sides) and shows the concept's own example of triangles A, B and C.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the child to count the equal sides of each triangle before reading the name. Then fold paper copies: A matches from every corner, C from one corner, B from none.

image_decisions.why: The three triangles side by side, with their ticks and arcs, let the child compare 3, 2 and no equal sides and see that equal angles follow equal sides.
